body: Integration-owner lesson (Opus2, 2026-11-11, my own wrong GO #995 to c593 on w-cf4b). Never authorize a whole-UI vitest as `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui`. --root changes Vitest's collection root but NOT process.cwd(), which the focused launcher sets to the repo root. Tests that read cwd-relative files (the category guard, styles.css and panel CSS readers) fail with ENOENT: test-e48a5d8d gave 5081 passed / 21 failed, all of them invocation failures. The supported routes are `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs category ui-unit|ui-component|ui-heavy|ui-app` (cwd ui, the full-gate config, no Test credit) or the full gate's vitest stage (cwd ui). Single-file focused vitest via `--root ui <file>` happened to pass in the cf4b RED run only because that file reads no cwd-relative paths.
